description: SkipHow continuity: print load and reload instructions at session boundaries without changing authority.

hooks.command: echo 'SkipHow is installed. When a project request matches the skiphow skill description, load its owner kernel, then read the repository instructions and live state before acting.'
echo 'SkipHow resumed. Load the skiphow owner kernel, then re-read the owner request, repository instructions, and live state before acting.'
